PART   I-A 
CENTRAL SECTION 
Orders  and  Notifications  (Other than those published in Part IV-B) 
under the Gujarat Local Boards, Village Panchayats, Municipal 
Boroughs, District Municipal, Primary Education and Local Fund Audit Acts. 
 
 
 
 
 
PANCHAYATS, RURAL HOUSING AND RURAL DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT 
NOTIFICATION 
Sachivalaya, Gandhinagar, 11th January, 2022 
GUJARAT PANCHAYATS ACT, 1993. 
No. KP/01/2022/PRR/102013/1864/KH:- In exercise of the powers conferred by section 227 read with sub-section (5) 
of section 274 of the Gujarat Panchayats Act, 1993 (Guj.18 of 1993), the Government of  Gujarat hereby makes the 
following rules further to amend the Gram  Sevak, Class III, in the Superior Panchayat Service Recruitment Rules, 2014, 
Namely:- 
1. 
    These rules may be called the Gram Sevak, Class III, in the Superior Panchayat Service Recruitment 
(Amendment) Rules, 2022.   
2. 
In the Gram Sevak, Class III in the Superior Panchayat Service, Recruitment Rules, 2014, in rule 3, in clause 
(b), in sub-clause (i)(a), after the words “Rural Development and Management”,  the words  “Rural Studies in 
Rural Farm Management / B.Sc. (Agriculture) or B.E. (Agriculture) / B.Sc. (Horticulture) ” shall be inserted. 
By order and in the name of the Governor of Gujarat, 
 
 
HITESH GOHIL, 
 
 
Deputy Secretary to Government. 
----------

2-1 
Signed by:Shri P. B. Kanwar
